reviewRules: Do not report formatting, naming, or personal style unless it causes a real problem.
Do not invent requirements or repository behavior.
If evidence is insufficient, omit the finding.
Check changed behavior for missing tests and regressions.
Treat authentication, authorization, secrets, user input, file access, SQL, shell execution, SSRF, deserialization and dependency changes as security-sensitive.
Consider backwards compatibility and API/schema changes.
